svg.title: Where the gain comes from
svg.desc: Training-tier decomposition of the gain by gene group. Un-calling the 35 cofactor-pool genes gives 62% of P1's gain; the mevalonate artefact costs 0.0014; the safer variant loses most of the cofactor-pool gain.
